summary.text: Katelyn Zach is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 133, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a Springfield case manager at a nonprofit that works with people experiencing homelessness, and named housing, public education and healthcare as campaign priorities.

paragraphs.text: Katelyn Zach grew up in Kansas and moved to Springfield, Missouri, for college, according to a Ballotpedia survey she completed in 2026.

She earned a degree in Political Science from Drury University and, while in school, worked at a local nonprofit focused on helping families achieve financial stability and homeownership in North Springfield.
Zach said she currently works as a case manager for a nonprofit in Springfield, helping people experiencing homelessness access stable housing and supportive services.
In the survey, Zach said her campaign supports expanding state funding for affordable housing development, strengthening tenant protections and expanding rental assistance.
She also said it supports fully funding K-12 public schools, increasing teacher pay, and expanding access to affordable higher education and vocational training.
Zach identified affordable healthcare as a third key message.
